component.name: Road Rash (OpenRash)
component.summary: Complete 1996 Road Rash (roadrash.fun) native Linux desktop edition

description.p: OpenRash delivers the complete 1996 Road Rash (roadrash.fun) experience as a native Linux desktop application powered by a C++20 GTK4, WebKitGTK 6.0, and libsoup-3.0 runtime with 100% of the game assets bundled for offline play.

Includes Quick Race (Thrash Mode), full 5-level Big Game Career mode across The City, The Peninsula, Pacific Coast Highway, Sierra Nevada, and Napa Valley, Olley's Bike Shop with all 15 bikes and showroom videos, 4 authentic cockpit dashboards, full grunge soundtrack jukebox, 56 FMV cutscenes, gamepad support, and online Mano-a-Mano multiplayer.

description.p: Complete native Linux desktop edition bundling 100% of roadrash.fun offline with hardware WebGL, FMV byte-range streaming, persistent career saves, and online Mano-a-Mano support.
